source.label: Annual Report and Form 20-F Information 2024, Shareholder information
source.quote: At 31 December 2024, the Company had 63,435 registered holders of 1,550,546,239 Ordinary Shares.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "Europe;United Kingdom;AstraZeneca PLC;Health Care;48006101810;4226875267;2.08%;2.08%". CalPERS: its Form 13F for the quarter ended December 31, 2024 lists no shares or ADRs of AstraZeneca. Holders of record: Registered holders of Ordinary Shares only. The same section separately lists 171,061 holders of Ordinary Shares held under the Euroclear Services Agreement (Sweden) and 1,513 registered holders of ADSs; these are not added.
